p1.title: Accuse counsel never yields advertised consequence
p1.narrative: HUMAN_LOOP and CHRONICLE require three reachable first-boundary histories, including Accuse now: a public allegation, strained Mara–Toma trust, and an attributed allegation that is not proof. In the playable Release Genesis path the Confront them publicly — risks trust control and accuseStake copy forecast that outcome, but the generated-world browser journey that issues that intent records rejected the advice, Standing Plan continued, and Research’s This accepted beat contains no allegation. Distinct public-accusation terminals exist only in fixture tests that force AccusePublicly or retune Mind; canonical Mara’s Standard Brain does not admit that history, so two of three advertised counsel intents do not produce materially different player-visible relationship/allegation consequences.

p1.title: Return next action is navigation only
p1.narrative: HUMAN_LOOP and PRODUCT require an explicit leave/advance/return then one outcome-legal second decision (repair, uphold, investigate, or observe) that can cause a later typed effect, and they forbid a return action that is only copy. After Chronicle, V1GenesisApp renders generated-sponsor-runtime nextAction solely as a worldFocus href (citizen/object/location). No second WorldCommand, receipt, or branch-legal option set exists; e2e covers Chronicle-to-focus and Copy factual trace, not a second authoritative choice. Repair-relationship and investigate-uncertainty therefore change camera/context only, leaving the sponsor loop incomplete.

p1.title: Forced-colors selected state is not visually distinguishable on V1 chrome
p1.narrative: docs/ACCESSIBILITY.md requires a usable forced-colors presentation, but the live V1 surfaces (.v1-world header toggles, settlement switcher, resident/building/project lists, focus actions) encode pressed/current state only with custom background, border-color, and inset box-shadow. The only @media (forced-colors: active) rules in apps/web/src/styles.css target leftover Riverhold classes, not V1. Under forced colors those fills/shadows are stripped, so Embodied vs World in words vs a selected resident can collapse to identical ButtonFace/ButtonText chrome. The e2e check only asserts outlineStyle !== none after Tab; it does not prove selected or view-mode state remains visible. Keyboard operation still works via aria-pressed, but a forced-colors user cannot see which world view or person is current.

p1.title: Mobile citizen focus hides the keyboard equivalents for canvas pan, zoom, and step
p1.narrative: The embodied canvas is role=img, not in the tab order, and documents drag/scroll plus semantic camera controls as the operating method. Those controls live in aside.v1-context-panel details.v1-world-tools (GeneratedEmbodimentControls: overview, zoom, orbit, pan, play/step). At max-width 720px, CSS sets display:none on .v1-world-tools (and the presence roster) whenever data-focus-kind is not overview. After a keyboard or roster select of a person—the path the footer instructs—pointer pan/zoom/pick on the canvas remain, but the keyboard/AT equivalents are removed from the accessibility tree. Follow/Back/Sponsor remain, and World in words remains, so the title is not unwinnable, but embodied keyboard/touch parity on the default mobile play path is broken for camera and reduced-motion stepping.

p1.title: Hosted Verify executes candidate CI and readiness code, so a post-review evidence commit can no-op required checks
p1.narrative: Independent inspection of 8eb6afa911cbe386e18dddd26f093aaeef9e5167...3b07af7828d6b5774472295e92f52620719afe44 shows the Mac intermediate and release-evidence finalizer correctly check out frozen control at inputs.frozen_candidate_sha, refuse to execute the evidence tree, and compare CONTROL_PATHS blobs before minting receipts. The protected Verify job does not. It is a single checkout of github.sha (pull_request merge ref or push HEAD) and then runs candidate scripts: classifyConditionalPaths from scripts/run-verification-tier.mjs, pnpm verify:pr, scripts/v1-github-evidence.mjs verify, and scripts/check-v1-readiness.mjs. GitHub evaluates pull_request workflows from that same PR merge commit, not from protected main. The post-freeze allowlist, SHA/ancestry/tag/receipt binding, and secret-scan job exist only as jobs and functions inside those candidate files. An evidence commit after this reviewed SHA can therefore replace .github/workflows/ci.yml (keeping job names Verify, Formal model, and Secret scan) and/or scripts/check-v1-readiness.mjs so hosted required checks go green without the frozen allowlist, live eight-run lattice, or gitleaks running. That is a candidate-controlled bootstrap hole in the exact phase the allowlist was meant to seal; human review of this freeze SHA does not inspect a later evidence commit. Premerge receipts remaining labeled PREMERGE_CANDIDATE_CONTROL does not close it, because the hosted gate that is supposed to consume those receipts is itself rewriteable from HEAD. Action pins, persist-credentials:false, contents/actions read, ignore-scripts install, checksum-pinned gitleaks/actionlint/TLC, tag/run/attempt artifact binding, in_progress push-to-main reattestation, merge-parent evidence SHA derivation, sandbox env stripping plus tested loopback/egress denial, CSP without unsafe-eval, vite/preview bound to 127.0.0.1, and no fetch/XHR/WebSocket in apps/web or packages were not treated as additional P0/P1 on this SHA.

p0.title: Active authorities still define Founder Alpha Riverhold, not Release Genesis V1
p0.narrative: docs/INDEX.md is the content-authority map and still points operators at product/quality/engineering files whose binding status and implementation behavior describe the Founder Alpha first slice, not the V1 civilization on this SHA. docs/product/PRODUCT.md remains the sole product authority and still states that the first proof is one Riverhold scenario rather than a general civilization, and that implementation must exclude generalized economy/governance, models, and Observatory UI. That contradicts GOAL.md rows already marked VERIFIED for Release Genesis, a generated world, institutions/economy/migration/founding, an executable local Model Brain treatment, and separated research/developer surfaces, and it also contradicts the public README.md / docs/GAMEPLAY.md Dawnmere loop. The same hierarchy is internally stale on release operability: docs/quality/TESTING.md still presents Founder Alpha mega PR #7 and historical FA CI counts as the implemented testing/CI contract; docs/quality/VISUAL_QA.md still requires Advance Riverhold and claims an independent exact-YES automated release gate; docs/quality/PERFORMANCE.md’s status line claims a clean PlayCanvas battery while later treating Founder Alpha head f818d10 as the release-valid measurement and a later V1 checkpoint as canonical-battery-pending; docs/engineering/PERSISTENCE.md’s status line still says V1 browser wiring is incomplete while the body and GOAL claim versioned IndexedDB is executable. INDEX also still lists docs/engineering/FOUNDER_ALPHA_RELEASE.md as an engineering authority for CI/release-status claims even though that file is labeled historical and disclaims current V1 operations. A coordinator following INDEX would ship, evidence, or block the wrong product. Public export classification on this tree has zero unclassified paths and zero forbidden-marker hits in included files; the defect is the live private authority set, not the sanitizer.

p1.title: Frozen SHA already contains V1 review JSON while GOAL says reviews are not started
p1.narrative: Commit 3b07af7828d6b5774472295e92f52620719afe44 tracks docs/reviews/V1_RV_PRODUCT.json, V1_RV_SYSTEMS.json, V1_RV_VISUAL.json, V1_RV_COGNITION.json, V1_RV_SECURITY_CI.json, and V1_RV_REPOSITORY_READINESS.json (introduced by 42a498d, message: close frozen readiness and world review findings). GOAL.md on this same SHA lists “Six frozen-SHA independent reviews” as NOT STARTED. Ready-mode release proof is supposed to bind GitHub-attested review payloads and then allow only an approved post-freeze docs/reviews/*.json tail. Having those exact artifact paths already inside the software freeze makes independent reviews non-constructible without colliding with or being mistaken for in-tree files, and it contradicts the execution ledger that operators use to decide whether the draft PR may be marked ready.
